raw.rationale: Raltitrexed is a broad-spectrum antifolate thymidylate synthase inhibitor whose activity depends mainly on FPGS-mediated polyglutamation and reduced folate carrier/transporter expression, so at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is expected to kill most proliferating cancer lines with little lineage selectivity; modest enrichment may occur in mesothelioma and colorectal models where antifolates are clinically active, but PRISM single-concentration data generally show few selective lineages.
